verdict.rationale: The evidence shows team collaboration features: team workspaces, collections shared with your team, team search, and user management in the self-host admin dashboard. That implies some access control over shared collections. However, nothing in the pack documents role types or separate view vs. edit permissions on APIs or collections. Missing for 10: documented roles (e.g. owner/editor/viewer), per-collection or per-workspace view/edit permission controls, hands-on or independent corroboration of access enforcement.
